title: Internal Architecture
description: Technical breakdown of the CLI internals.

sections.title: CLI Entry Point
sections.content: The entry point in `bin/cli.mjs` orchestrates the tool. It parses arguments, handles help flags, and uses dynamic imports to load only the required command module, keeping the CLI fast.

examples.explanation: Logic flow of a CLI command

sections.title: The Template Engine
sections.content: Nodibranch uses a "Functional Template" approach. While `init` uses static files, route and controller generation uses JavaScript functions in `src/models/` that return template strings, allowing for dynamic injection of names and filtered methods.
